meta.title: Commercial Pressure Washing in Raleigh, NC | AAA Houston Pressure Washing, LLC

hero.h1: Commercial Pressure Washing Services in Raleigh & Surrounding Cities
hero.intro: Professional exterior cleaning for businesses, property managers, and commercial property owners across Raleigh, Cary, Apex, Garner, Wake Forest, Durham, Holly Springs, Clayton, Fuquay-Varina, and Morrisville.

categories_section.heading: Commercial Exterior Cleaning Services
categories_section.subheading: Every Surface. Every Property Type. Fully Insured.
categories_section.intro: From parking lots and loading docks to building facades and specialty industrial assets — we handle every commercial exterior cleaning need across Raleigh and surrounding cities.

categories.heading: Hardscapes & Flatwork
categories.intro: These high-traffic ground surfaces are the most common areas requiring commercial washing due to heavy foot traffic, vehicles, and weather exposure.

services.name: Sidewalks & Entryways
services.desc: Removes chewing gum, heavy soda spills, food stains, and layers of gray foot-traffic grime.

services.name: Parking Lots & Parking Garages
services.desc: Cleans entire concrete or asphalt parking zones, lifting tire tracks, brake dust, and mud.

services.name: Oil & Fluid Stains
services.desc: Blasts away dark oil spots, transmission fluid drips, and antifreeze stains left by leaking vehicles.

services.name: Drive-Thru Lanes
services.desc: Cleans concentrated buildup of heavy engine oil, exhaust soot, and spilled food or drinks at fast-food lanes and bank kiosks.

services.name: Loading Docks & Delivery Bays
services.desc: Removes heavy industrial grime, grease, tire marks from semi-trucks, and forklift tracks.

services.name: Dumpster Pads & Enclosures
services.desc: Sanitizes and scrubs the concrete slab where trash bins sit — washing away leaked garbage fluids, rotting organic matter, and foul smells.

services.name: Patios, Courtyards & Plazas
services.desc: Deep cleans outdoor dining areas, community plazas, and brick walkways used for public gatherings.

services.name: Stairwells & Parking Ramps
services.desc: Cleans enclosed or outdoor concrete staircases and multi-level garage ramps to remove slippery algae and trash stains.

services.name: Gas Station Pump Islands
services.desc: Dissolves diesel and gasoline spills, grease, and grime around fuel pumps.

categories.heading: Building Structural Exteriors
categories.intro: These services restore the exterior of the property to prevent structural damage and keep the building looking fresh and professional.

services.name: Storefronts & Facades
services.desc: Refreshes retail frontages, removing cobwebs, bird droppings, dust, and spider webs from customer entrances.

services.name: Building Siding & Walls
services.desc: Washes large vertical walls made of brick, concrete, stucco, EIFS, metal panels, or wood siding to clear atmospheric pollution and dirt.

services.name: High-Rise & Multi-Story Exteriors
services.desc: Cleans the walls of tall commercial buildings utilizing boom lifts, scaffolding, or water-fed extension poles.

services.name: Mold, Mildew & Algae Removal
services.desc: Eradicates green or black organic growth thriving on shaded walls, columns, and foundations.

services.name: Graffiti Removal
services.desc: Uses heavy heat, pressure, and special chemical strippers to lift spray paint and permanent markers from brick or masonry.

services.name: Rust & Efflorescence Stain Removal
services.desc: Cleans orange rust streaks caused by battery acid or hard-water irrigation, and removes white powdery salt buildup on masonry.

services.name: Awnings & Canopies
services.desc: Gently washes fabric, vinyl, or metal awnings above storefront doors to remove bird droppings and mold.

services.name: Commercial Roofs
services.desc: Soft-washes flat or sloped commercial roofs to clear away black algae streaks, moss, lichen, and accumulated leaves or bird debris.

categories.heading: Fencing, Boundaries & Landscape Elements
categories.intro: The structures surrounding the main property require routine cleaning to preserve security, safety, and professional appearance.

services.name: Retaining Walls & Privacy Fences
services.desc: Cleans stone, brick, concrete block, or vinyl perimeter fences surrounding commercial layouts.

services.name: Dumpster Gates & Enclosure Walls
services.desc: Washes the wood, chain-link, or brick walls that enclose commercial trash bins.

services.name: Monuments & Pylon Signage
services.desc: Washes large concrete, brick, or plastic signs near roads that display the business name and logo.

services.name: Curbs, Gutters & Bollards
services.desc: Cleans the concrete edges of parking lots, storm drains, and safety posts to keep their safety paint bright and visible.

categories.heading: Specialty Industrial & Commercial Assets
categories.intro: Specialized niche cleaning targets that require commercial-grade equipment and expertise to handle safely and effectively.

services.name: Heavy Machinery & Construction Equipment
services.desc: Blasts thick mud, grease, and hydraulic oil off bulldozers, excavators, tractors, and cranes.

services.name: Commercial Vehicle Fleets
services.desc: Washes rows of delivery vans, semi-trucks, trailers, box trucks, or transit buses.

services.name: Shopping Carts & Cart Corrals
services.desc: Sanitizes metal or plastic shopping carts and the outdoor metal stalls where customers return them.

services.name: Playgrounds & Park Equipment
services.desc: Sanitizes and washes plastic, metal, or wood playground structures at daycares, fast-food restaurants, and public parks.

services.name: Stadia & Bleachers
services.desc: Cleans large seating areas, concrete steps, and concession areas inside sports arenas or outdoor amphitheaters.

cities.h3: Parking Lots, Storefronts, Building Exteriors & More
